newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to sell device allowing Internet on TV.
newsitem.headline: NTT to sell device allowing Internet on TV.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Monday it would launch a digital device that allows users to access the Internet through their television set.
The InfoJack-Box, a box-like device set on top of the television set, will be launched on June 13, NTT said in a statement.
"It is the first device of this type that works with a digital circuit," an NTT spokesman said.
The device will be priced at 74,000 yen and NTT expects to sell 5,000 units per year, the company said.
